goal: BENCHMARK, design only. Judged against 'reference' (a pipeline published by Comfy-Org or the model vendor): the agent's stages must reach the same result with free models - the same kind of steps in the same order, each fed by the right earlier output, prompts that describe exactly what was asked, and a design that holds with every ? answered. Nothing is installed or run.

reference.source: Comfy-Org Applied template_image_speech_to_video (structure; ElevenLabs voice + LTX-2.3 image-audio-to-video). Free routes: a model that speaks the line itself (LTX-2.x audio-video, MiniMax H3)
steps: (optional) a still of them framed for the shot from the photo
still -> video with the spoken line and lip-sync (audio-video model)
must: the spoken line quoted exactly in the prompt, in the model's dialogue format
a model that generates speech or takes audio

turns.text: Here's a photo of me. Make a short vertical video of me looking into the camera and saying: 'Hey everyone, I've got big news - the new collection drops Friday.'
